   112→def canonical_digest(root: Path, relative_paths: list[str]) -> str:
   113→    digest = hashlib.sha256()
   114→    for rel in sorted(relative_paths):
   115→        path = root / rel
   116→        digest.update(rel.encode()); digest.update(b"\0"); digest.update(path.read_bytes()); digest.update(b"\0")
   117→    return "sha256:" + digest.hexdigest()
